headline: Anthropic's second day on the stock exchange. Here's what's happening with the shares
summary: Anthropic shares fell about 10% on Friday, a day after closing their debut session up 17%.
why: Anthropic is a US artificial intelligence company that develops the Claude family of AI models. Its market debut gives investors a new listed reference point for AI valuations.
why_moved: The report gives the decline and the prior day's gain but no cause for the move.
original_headline: Drugi dzień Anthropic na giełdzie. Oto co się dzieje z akcjami
